title: neomirandea psoralea
intro: Neomirandea psoralea, commonly known as Psoralea, is a plant species that belongs to the legume family and is native to tropical and subtropical regions of Asia. The health benefits of Neomirandea psoralea include its traditional use in the treatment of various health conditions, such as osteoporosis, as it is believed to promote bone health due to its high calcium content. The therapeutic actions of Neomirandea psoralea include its ability to stimulate cell growth, inhibit inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Neomirandea psoralea include isoflavones, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
